subject: Re: MAP — security & DPA alignment / close timeline
messages:
From: Erin Shaw <erin.shaw@initiatecloud.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: matt.oneal@initiatecloud.com, procurement@initiatecloud.com
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: security gate alignment for Initiate Cloud evaluation

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks again for taking time on Friday. As we start to lock down our mutual action plan (MAP) for the POC/ eval, a couple of security and legal items are blocking our internal approval. Wanted to share our baseline and ask for confirmation on Redwood's side so we can firm up timeline to close by the end of April. Attached: InitiateCloud_requirements_v1.pdf (contains our SOC 2 checklist, DPA template, and retention windows).

Top asks from our side:
- SOC 2 report: do you have a current Type II report and the review period?
- SIG/CAIQ: can Redwood map controls to our SIG matrix and provide a completed CAIQ/attestation?
- DPA: we attached a standard redline; are you able to accept the EU residency and 90-day delete-on-request clause?
- Data retention: need clarity on retention tiers for logs, embeddings, and raw customer content (we'd like a 30/90/365 day tier mapping).

We'd like to propose the following MAP milestones (internal):
1) Security intake + SIG mapping — Mar 22
2) DPA negotiation + redline — Mar 24
3) SOC 2 evidence delivery — Mar 29
4) Final exec review + sign — Apr 1

Can you confirm Redwood's owners and whether any of these are blockers? If helpful, we can set a short working call tomorrow.

Best,
Erin
Erin Shaw
Head of Procurement, Initiate Cloud
Erin Shaw | Initiate Cloud

Attachments: InitiateCloud_requirements_v1.pdf
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Shaw <erin.shaw@initiatecloud.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: security gate alignment for Initiate Cloud evaluation

Hi Erin —

Thanks for the note and the clear list. Appreciate the timeline — it's tight but doable with focused owners. Below is a proposed MAP split focused on the security/compliance gates you listed. I'm including owners on our side.

Mutual Action Plan (security/compliance slice) — Redwood owners
- SIG/CAIQ mapping: deliver completed CAIQ spreadsheet + narrative (owner: Jonas Weber, due: Mar 24)
- DPA redline review: legal review + proposed concession matrix (owner: Kimberly Park, due: Mar 24)
- SOC 2: we will provide our most recent Type II (covering Oct 2025–Sep 2026) and the SOC bridge letter for any gap (owner: Kimberly Park, deliverable by Mar 26)
- Data retention mapping: call out retention by data type (embeddings, debug logs, raw content) and retention APIs (owner: Vanessa Ortiz, due: Mar 24)
- Evidence access & audits: propose a secure share for artifacts + audit window scheduling (owner: Jonas, due: Mar 29)

We will attach the SIG mapping and an initial DPA redline for your team to review. Noting the EU residency clause — happy to discuss a scoped data residency commitment for customer data and exec-level approval route for any cross-border exceptions.

Proposed working cadence:
- Quick working call — Tue, Mar 23, 9:30am PT (30m) to walk SIG mapping and DPA redline
- Follow-up draft deliverables — Fri, Mar 26
- Final exec touchpoint — Wed, Mar 31

Please confirm the call or propose a different time. If you want the SIG worksheet earlier, Jonas can email it ahead of the call.

Thanks —
Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SIG-CAIQ-matrix.xlsx
From: Matt O'Neal <matt.oneal@initiatecloud.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: Erin Shaw <erin.shaw@initiatecloud.com>, procurement@initiatecloud.com
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: security gate alignment for Initiate Cloud evaluation

Vanessa / team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming the working call for Tue the 23rd didn't work for us (calendar conflict) so Erin and I pulled the team together this morning and did a quick review of the attached SIG worksheet — looks like good coverage overall. Couple of clarifications from legal / security after an initial skim:

1) SOC 2 period: your Oct 2025–Sep 2026 Type II is OK, but we need an attestation that there were no material exceptions impacting encryption-in-transit or access control during the period.
2) DPA redline: our counsel has attached a marked-up DPA (see DPA-redline-v2.docx). The sticking point is the 90-day delete-on-request for backups — we asked for a carveout to allow 180 days for backup retention in exceptional restore cases.
3) Retention table: can you confirm which tokens/embeddings are treated as ephemeral vs. persistent? Our evaluation will ingest test PII; we need explicit scrub APIs or auto-redaction options called out.

Attached the DPA redline and our legal summary. Proposed timeline (per our calendar constraints):
- DPA negotiation wrap — Mar 31
- SOC 2 confirmation and attestation — Apr 2
- Final sign & procurement approval — Apr 7

Is there any chance Redwood can agree to the 180-day backup carveout if we scope it to incident recovery only and include a notification process?

Thanks,
Matt O'Neal
Senior Legal Counsel, Initiate Cloud

Attachments: DPA-redline-v2.docx
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Shaw <erin.shaw@initiatecloud.com>, Matt O'Neal <matt.oneal@initiatecloud.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: security gate alignment for Initiate Cloud evaluation

Erin / Matt —

Appreciate the clarity and the redline. A few concrete responses and commitments from Redwood:

1) SOC 2 / attestation: we confirm our SOC 2 Type II (Oct 2025–Sep 2026). We'll provide the bridge letter and an explicit statement re: no material exceptions to encryption-in-transit and access control in that period. Delivery: Mar 26.

2) SIG/CAIQ: Jonas will send the completed CAIQ and an annotated mapping showing where controls meet your matrix. Delivery: Mar 24.

3) DPA / backup retention: We can accept an exception to increase backup retention to 180 days but limited to disaster recovery restores where we have documented incident rationale and with advance notice to Initiate Cloud. We will add an approval & notification process to the DPA redline (see proposed concession language). If that scope is acceptable to your counsel, we can proceed to final wording.

4) Data retention: Redwood retention tiers (proposed):
- Embeddings: ephemeral by default, 30 days for evaluation mode unless explicitly configured to persist
- Application logs (debug/traces): 90 days default, with an opt-in extended retention for compliance customers
- Raw uploaded content: 365 days with on-demand deletion APIs and a documented deletion SLA (30 days to fully remove from active stores; backups 180-day window per above)

5) Evidence access: we'll create a secure artifact share and provide a 2-hour walkthrough of any requested items (Jonas to schedule).

Next steps:
- We'll attach the DPA redline with the proposed backup carveout language and concession matrix into the HubSpot deal record by EOD Thu, Mar 25. (Doc link will be shared)
- If acceptable, sign-off target: Apr 7 per your calendar.

Would you like a 30-minute legal-to-legal call to land the DPA language Thursday morning? We're available 9–11am PT.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Head of Legal, Redwood Inference
